# Instructions for AI coding agents

- Keep changes small and focused on the issue you were given.
- Allergen keywords live in `allergens.js`. Add new keywords there rather than in `index.html`.
- Every bug fix must include a test in `allergens.test.js` that would have failed before the fix.
- Run `node --test` and make sure all tests pass before asking for review.
- Write the pull request description in plain English so non-developers can follow it.
